full_judgment: 42. Sub-section (1), section 235 also provides for trial of more than one offence, but the limitation laid down is that the offences must arise from the same transaction. The section lays down no limitation as to time or number of offences. The only condition is that one series of acts must be so connected together as to form the same transaction and the offences are committed in that series of acts. Sub- section (2) of section 235 deals with offences falling within two or more separate definitions, and sub- section (3) with acts constituting one offence, but when combined constituting a different offence.
